description: A timeless set of 500 colorful Lego bricks that encourages creativity and problem-solving. Kids can build anything they imagine — from houses to vehicles and entire cities! Compatible with all Lego sets.
A delightful 500-piece rainbow puzzle featuring vibrant colors and whimsical cloud designs. Perfect for kids aged 6+ to develop patience, concentration, and spatial thinking skills.
Unearth your inner paleontologist! Dig through platforms to discover hidden dinosaur fossils. Includes 3 fossils, excavation tools, brush, and a full-color identification booklet with dino facts.
Premium magnetic tiles that click together to form stunning 3D structures. Encourages STEM learning, geometry, color recognition, and architectural creativity. Safe rounded edges for toddlers.
An enchanting 18-piece tea party set featuring a pastel teapot, 4 cups, saucers, plates, and pretend food. Made from BPA-free plastic. Sparks imagination and develops social play skills.
Safe foam rocket that launches up to 30 feet in the air! Pump-action blaster with 6 colorful foam rockets. Perfect for outdoor play, active kids, and backyard adventures.
A gorgeous 45-piece wooden train set with a figure-8 track, bridges, tunnels, trees, and 2 trains. Premium birch wood construction. Develops fine motor skills and imaginative play.
Make 10 different types of slime — glitter, magnetic, color-changing, glow-in-the-dark, and more! Everything included in one box. Non-toxic, mess-containment guarantee for parents.
A complete art studio in a box! Includes 48 colored pencils, 24 watercolors, 12 acrylic paints, brushes, canvas boards, and a project idea booklet. For budding artists aged 5+.
High-speed RC off-road buggy with 2.4GHz control, 360° spins, and up to 25km/h speed. Waterproof shell, rechargeable battery, 40min play time. Works on carpet, grass, and outdoor terrain.
